q1_navigated.decision: retain GUARD_DIGITS=30 if every backend_ms and first_region_ms upper 95% bound <= 1.05; reject if any backend_ms lower bound > 1.05; otherwise inconclusive. reference_ms is reported with its absolute delta and does not decide alone.

q2_restored_shared.decision: hypothesis 'same inflated input costs the same on both builds' is confirmed for a metric if its 95% interval lies within [0.95, 1.05].

q2_cycled_own.decision: camera/UI arithmetic improvement is established for a metric if its upper bound <= 0.90; render metrics follow the control rule (upper <= 1.05 pass, lower > 1.05 fail). Hypothesis 'render barely changes' is confirmed if render intervals lie within [0.95, 1.05].

statistics: B/A ratio of matching sample index within each process pair; median of ratios; seeded hierarchical bootstrap (5000 resamples, process pairs then samples), as in summarize_baseline_pairs.paired_statistics
